items.subject: AP materiality
items.body: Price and duty variances under $1,000 are logged, not escalated, unless the same thing keeps happening. Quantity problems always come to me until resolved.

items.subject: Weight-count tolerance for fasteners
items.body: Effective today, when the dock counts fasteners by weight, we accept the invoice quantity if the shortfall is 0.60% or less (was 1%). Anything over that gets a recount. Three short deliveries in a row still come to me.

items.subject: Bank detail changes — new rule after the Hoshi near-miss
items.body: No remit-to change goes into the vendor master from an email, ever. AP calls the supplier on the number already on file, documents the call, and sends me a vendor-change request. I approve; AP never edits the vendor master. Same for employees: direct-deposit changes only through HRIS self-service, verified by HR — never from an email to payroll.
